Services

Problems first. Technology second.

I work backward from the business problem, then choose the right mix of analysis, design, AI and software to solve it.

01 / ANALYTICS

Unclear decisions & unreliable information

Custom dashboards, auditing systems, anomaly detection, forecasting views, and evidence-based reporting interfaces.

02 / WORKFLOWS

Manual, fragmented or inefficient work

Practical workflow design, structured analysis, recommendations, review steps, and human-in-the-loop decision support.

03 / EXPERIENCES

Complex knowledge people cannot easily explore

Searchable explorers, timelines, maps, knowledge interfaces, and custom business tools that make complex information usable.

How I work

Understand. Design. Build. Validate.

A disciplined, problem-solving process focused on useful outcomes — not technology for its own sake.

01 / DISCOVER

Diagnose the problem

Understand the audience, workflow, business goal, and what better decisions would look like.

02 / STRUCTURE

Define what success looks like

Map sources, rules, constraints, assumptions, and the information that really matters.

03 / BUILD

Build a usable solution

Develop a usable experience, iterate quickly, and test it with realistic scenarios.

04 / REFINE

Test and improve

Improve usability, governance, validation, handoff, and integration readiness.

Meet the founder

Brian Brennan / Founder

Brian Brennan is a business strategist, analytics leader, and AI solutions developer with more than 20 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex challenges. His career spans marketing strategy, media operations, data analytics, and client-facing leadership, including building a digital media division and leading large-scale national accounts.

Today, Brian combines that experience with AI-assisted development to turn challenging business questions into practical, working solutions. From marketing accountability and startup go-to-market execution to interactive educational tools, his approach starts with understanding the problem—not forcing the technology.

He founded Nova Forge Solutions around a simple belief: complex problems deserve intelligent, usable solutions.
